name: Security Scan
description: Run a single-pass, evidence-bounded source security assessment with validated findings and a coverage receipt.
author: Dyadic
abilities: Pins an immutable source snapshot and maps trust boundaries
Discovers and validates source-to-sink security findings
Records counterevidence, negative results, and coverage limits
permissions: Runtime probes require the target-specific authorization and Dyadic approval applicable to the selected tool
Does not submit reports, modify source, or create issues unless separately requested

changes.notes: Initial Dyadic-native single-pass security assessment workflow.
